settings.title: How do I place an order on Spoofy?
settings.content: Browse products, add items to cart, and proceed to checkout to complete your purchase.

settings.title: Are your products suitable for all pets?
settings.content: Our products are curated for different pet needs. Please check product descriptions before purchase.

settings.title: Do I need an account to place an order?
settings.content: No, you can place an order as a guest, but creating an account helps track orders easily.

settings.title: How long will my order take to arrive?
settings.content: Orders are dispatched within 1–2 business days and delivered within 2–10 days depending on location.

settings.title: What are the delivery charges?
settings.content: Shipping charges depend on order value and location. Free shipping may be available above a certain amount.

settings.title: How can I track my order?
settings.content: You will receive a tracking link via email/SMS once your order is shipped.

settings.title: What payment methods are available?
settings.content: We accept UPI, cards, net banking, and Cash on Delivery.

settings.title: Is Cash on Delivery available?
settings.content: Yes, COD is available with a small additional fee.
